title: Tudor Square and half the publishing on Sometime You Get It
summary: Ridgley recorded for Sansu, the station dropped it for lack of money, and Marshall agreed to give half the publishing so Ridgley could release it on Tudor Square.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song
